messages:
Amelia: thinking out loud — we need a lightweight way in Console to "who changed this routing rule" during a canary. not the full NDJSON export, just the immediate breadcrumbs tied to the rollout id.
Raj: +1. customers keep asking for an in-console trace: rule -> change author -> canary id -> revert link.
Derek: question: do we build this on top of the current /exports path or add a streaming /audit/preview endpoint?
Amelia: prefer not to overload /exports (it's heavy and has throttles). a streaming preview for UI would let us show last 30 events cheaply.
Marie: telemetry/cost concern — even tailing 30 events for many users could add up. we need per-project preview quota and cheap sample mode.
Raj: proposal: two primitives: 1) /audit/preview?rule_id=X returns recent compact events (no PII) 2) /audit/export for full NDJSON with redaction flags. preview is cached 30s and counts toward a tiny preview quota.
Derek: agreed. preview payload shape should be compact: {actor, verb, target, rollout_id, diff_snippet}. no full object snapshots.
Amelia: UI idea: show "Recent Changes (preview)" with a "View full audit" CTA that triggers an export job (async) and returns a presigned download link.
Marie: exports must be rate-limited and billable. we should attach an export_quota check and an export job id. also add retention metadata (e.g., expires_at).
Raj: sample curl for the preview endpoint so we can prototype UI:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/preview?rule_id=rb-123&limit=25"
```
Response should be small.
Derek: how about live tail in the console for tenant admins (ws)? preview covers most use cases but for on-call we might want a live websocket tail with same compact shape and ACL checks.
Amelia: live ws is powerful but opens new telemetry surfaces. we should gate it behind an entitlement and only enable for Dedicated/Private accounts.
Marie: compliance angle: exports need proof ties (signed manifest) so legal can verify who downloaded what when. add a presigned manifest that includes checksum and signer_id.
Amelia: good call. compliance-bot: scheduled snapshot for regulatory retention will churn exports — we need a better export scheduling UI.
compliance-bot: reminder — scheduled daily snapshots for tenants with retention > 180d must be approved by compliance.
Raj: UI UX: make preview immutable and show a tiny "why is this missing?" hint when events are redacted (PII or privileged change).
Derek: API debate: extend existing /exports to accept a compact_format param vs new /audit/export. I'm leaning to separate surface to keep responsibilities clear.
Marie: separate endpoint reduces accidental heavy queries from the Console JS. also easier to add quotas/entitlements per endpoint.
Amelia: quick follow-up: add a routing-proof-id to every change event during rollout so console can link event -> rollout stage. that avoids having to compute diffs client-side.
Raj: agreement. I'll sketch the proto and include sample payloads for preview vs export. will ping design for the small badge on rollout UI.
Amelia: thanks — if we can get a tiny prototype by EOD tomorrow we can run it with infra for telemetry cost estimates. :thumbsup:
Marie: will add quota numbers and cost model to the doc after Raj posts proto.
Derek: logging note — ensure preview hits are sampled in metrics so we can measure Console-induced load separately.
Amelia: ok locking this thread. will open a PR with the proto + UI mockups.
compliance-bot: automated note — created ticket #PLT-9832 for "audit preview + export separation" and linked to this thread.
